public.text: Identity verification against biometric services and foundational sources is included as a core attribute, but verification and identity resolution are different capabilities with different legal authority and assurance.
public.suggestedRevision: Separate identity resolution, verification, authentication, credential validation, and biometric matching. Define which are provided by the Client Registry and which are consumed from external services.
